4869645.name: Caleb Douglas
4869645.short: Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

4870598.name: CJ Allen
4870598.short: Allen (ankle) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough.

4870612.name: Zachariah Branch
4870612.short: Coach Kevin Stefanski noted Monday that Branch (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Bengals, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

4870653.name: KC Concepcion
4870653.short: Concepcion caught three of four targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

4870706.name: Caleb Downs
4870706.short: Downs is in the league's concussion protocol after being injured in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

4870795.name: Makai Lemon
4870795.short: Lemon caught six of nine targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders.

4870808.name: Jeremiyah Love
4870808.short: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love suffered a "new" ankle injury during Sunday's overtime win at Dallas, and that he'll have an update on the running back later this week, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

4870847.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
4870847.short: Lane caught his only target for 13 yards in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills.

4870953.name: Malik Muhammad II
4870953.short: Muhammad (toe) is inactive for Monday's game against the Seahawks.

4870988.name: Avieon Terrell
4870988.short: Terrell (back/illness) is active for Sunday's game against Tampa Bay.

4870998.name: Josiah Trotter
4870998.short: Trotter (illness) was a full participant at the Buccaneers' practice Thursday.

4871063.name: Peter Woods
4871063.short: Woods (neck) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's contest against the Broncos.

4874509.name: DJ Giddens
4874509.short: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.

4879276.name: Bryce Lance
4879276.short: Lance reeled in all two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh.

4880236.name: Will Kacmarek
4880236.short: Kacmarek (hamstring) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's battle against the Patriots, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

4880281.name: Jordyn Tyson
4880281.short: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that the Saints will decide by Wednesday whether to open Tyson's (hamstring) 21-day practice window this week, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

4882093.name: Bhayshul Tuten
4882093.short: Tuten was a non-participant at Monday's walkthrough due to ankle and foot injuries.

4883647.name: Elic Ayomanor
4883647.short: Ayomanor caught three of five targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

4887558.name: Emanuel Wilson
4887558.short: Wilson is welcoming back Zach Charbonnet (knee) and Jadarian Price (chest) to the Seahawks backfield for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

4890973.name: Ashton Jeanty
4890973.short: Jeanty rushed twice for nine yards while catching three of four targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

4896353.name: Jimmy Rolder
4896353.short: Rolder will miss the remainder of the season due to a hamstring injury, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

4905664.name: A.J. Haulcy
4905664.short: Haulcy produced nine tackles (five solo) in a loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

4911851.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
4911851.short: Allen (hamstring) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

4912218.name: Cyrus Allen
4912218.short: Allen caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

4912274.name: Sione Vaki
4912274.short: Vaki rushed 11 times for 65 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added one catch for five yards on one target.

4950400.name: Arvell Reese
4950400.short: Reese posted seven tackles (five solo), including 0.5 sacks, in Sunday's 27-21 overtime victory against the Texans.

4954445.name: Dillon Thieneman
4954445.short: Thieneman tallied eight tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, in a 30-24 victory versus the Patriots on Thursday.

5081335.name: Drew Stevens
5081335.short: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

5081394.name: James Pearce Jr.
5081394.short: The NFL reinstated Pearce on Monday after he served his eight-game suspension for violating the league's personal conduct policy, Darius Hayes of Sports Illustrated reports.

5081397.name: Dylan Sampson
5081397.short: Sampson rushed one time for seven yards and caught six of eight targets for 62 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

5081432.name: Antonio Williams
5081432.short: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

5081807.name: Sonny Styles
5081807.short: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

5081999.name: CJ Donaldson
5081999.short: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

5082269.name: Dean Connors
5082269.short: Connors suffered a broken hand in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Rams.

5082424.name: Dominic Zvada
5082424.short: Head coach John Harbaugh reiterated Monday that he's confident in Zvada and said that the Giants have no plans to work out other kickers, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

5083076.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
5083076.short: Fannin brought in 10 of 12 targets for 154 yards in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

5083315.name: Kenyon Sadiq
5083315.short: Sadiq caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

5083754.name: Ryan Flournoy
5083754.short: Flournoy caught three of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.short: Young went without a target while playing 19 of the Bengals' 74 snaps on offense in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

5093923.name: Andrew Armstrong
5093923.short: Armstrong caught one of two targets for three yards during Sunday night's 20-3 loss to Seattle.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.short: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

5150660.name: Anterio Thompson
5150660.short: Thompson posted on social media this week that he was diagnosed with a genetic mutation on his spinal cord in early May and indicated that he was told he will "never play football again," Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

5151083.name: Will Lee III
5151083.short: Lee (hamstring) is day to day but should have a chance to "test" his injury this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.short: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.short: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.short: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
